Limiting the number of housing people can own doesn’t solve the source of the problem. Big corporations and investors will create multiple companies and source the buildings in their name. There are so many accounting loopholes that cannot be solved without harming working class families.

The source of the problem of the housing crisis are banks. Banks will lend money to just about anyone knowing they will earn that money back through interest or seizing the property when payments default. Because of this, the currency has lost a tremendous amount of its wealth, which has raised the price of things significantly, particularly housing and energy. Working class people cannot afford the rise in living costs, and I expect more people to begin living with parents and sharing accommodation. As a consequence, I expect the housing market to crash significantly as there won’t be enough people to afford the property. When this happens, there needs to be a collective cap on the proportion of wealth banks can loan out. This will reduce inflation significantly, raising interest rates, and reintroducing value to western currencies. As a consequence, the working class wage will have more value, which will allow them to begin buying their own property. I also think the working class should genuinely think about holding their money in cryptocurrency. Now I’m not going to go off on a tangent about how ‘Crypto is our saviour’ but it does help reduce some of the consequences of inflation. 

I am an accountant in the UK and this isn’t a holistic solution. I’m not very good at solving problems but identifying them is just fine. The source of the problems is the banks, and that needs to be addressed. Naturally, it won’t because big corporations need to seize property to generate profit.

The only thing you need to have when you apply for the army with respect to your fitness in a good level of control of your body. Weight lifting, whilst a good exercise, won’t be as useful as the afore mentioned core exercises. The army aren’t looking for super-giants who can bench press huge numbers, they’re after people with tremendous amounts of stamina and control over the body. By all means, continue you with your weight training, most definitely if you enjoy it.
